Colour Middling Objects

Everything built out of the art collection's own colours lives here and nowhere else — new objects are added to this page rather than published as new ones. Nothing is tinted: every block is an exact hex from a saved artwork, so press and hold any block to see the work it came from. Tell me what works at the bottom, and the next object gets designed against that instead of from scratch.

What you've recorded so far

Objects are generated by scripts/build_theme.py and scripts/build_waterfall.py, then merged into this one page by scripts/build_objects.py. Every slot in a designed ramp is backed by dozens of near-identical real colours, which keeps flat sprite areas while leaving each block a different artwork; each cell walks its slot's cycle at its own phase, so a surface breathes rather than sparkles. Feedback is stored in the artifact's own database, not in your browser, which is what makes it readable later.
